verses.text_big5_plain: 作長老的寫信給親愛的該猶，就是我真實所愛的。

According to the contents of this Epistle, he must have been an outstanding brother in the church.

refs.text_big5: 親愛的，我願你凡事興盛，身體健康，正如你的魂興盛一樣。
refs.text_en: Beloved, concerning all things I wish that you may prosper and be in health, even as your soul prospers.

refs.text_gb: 亲爱的，凡你向作客旅之弟兄所行的，都是忠信的；
refs.text_big5: 親愛的，凡你向作客旅之弟兄所行的，都是忠信的；
refs.text_en: Beloved, you do faithfully in whatever you have wrought for the brothers, and this for strangers,

refs.text_gb: 亲爱的，不要效法恶，只要效法善。行善的是出于神，行恶的未曾见过神。
refs.text_big5: 親愛的，不要效法惡，只要效法善。行善的是出於神，行惡的未曾見過神。
refs.text_en: Beloved, do not imitate the evil, but the good. He who does good is of God; he who does evil has not seen God.

refs.text_gb: 作长老的写信给蒙拣选的夫人和她的儿女，就是我真实所爱的；不单我爱，也是一切认识真理之人所爱的；

footnotes.en: 1:2 3 prospers The Greek word means to go on well, as in a journey (Rom. 1:10). I.e., to succeed in reaching a desired end; thus, to prosper.

footnotes.zh_big5: 指身體的健康，如在路五31，七10，十五27者。
footnotes.en: 1:2 4 health Bodily health, as in Luke 5:31; 7:10; 15:27.

footnotes.zh: 人有三部分：灵、魂、体(帖前五23与注5)。魂是介于体与灵之间的器官，有自觉，使人有其个格。魂包含在体里，且是盛装灵的器皿。对信徒而言，是灵的神居住在他重生的灵里(罗八9，16)，并从他的灵里扩展，浸透他的魂，使魂得着变化，以彰显神(罗十二2，林后三18)。这就是信徒的魂兴盛。当我们的魂借着我们的灵被神的灵占有并支配，好为着神的定旨支配并使用我们的体时，魂就兴盛。使徒盼望他的受信者，这位魂格外兴盛的亲爱弟兄，能凡事兴盛，身体健康，正如他的魂在神的生命里兴盛一样。
footnotes.zh_big5: 人有三部分：靈、魂、體。（帖前五23與註5。）魂是介於體與靈之間的器官，有自覺，使人有其個格。魂包含在體裏，且是盛裝靈的器皿。對信徒而言，是靈的神居住在他重生的靈裏，（羅八9，16，）並從他的靈裏擴展，浸透他的魂，使魂得著變化，以彰顯神。（羅十二2，林後三18。）這就是信徒的魂興盛。當我們的魂藉著我們的靈被神的靈佔有並支配，好為著神的定旨支配並使用我們的體時，魂就興盛。使徒盼望他的受信者，這位魂格外興盛的親愛弟兄，能凡事興盛，身體健康，正如他的魂在神的生命裏興盛一樣。
footnotes.en: 1:2 5 soul Man is of three parts: spirit, soul, and body (1 Thes. 5:23 and note 1 Thes. 5:23 5 ). The soul is the organ that mediates between the body and the spirit; it possesses self-consciousness, that man may have his personality. It is contained in the body and is the vessel to contain the spirit. As to the believer, God as the Spirit dwells in his regenerated spirit (Rom. 8:9, 16) and spreads from his spirit to saturate his soul that it may be transformed to express Him (Rom. 12:2; 2 Cor. 3:18). This is the prosperity of the believer's soul. When our soul is occupied and directed by the Spirit of God through our spirit so that it directs and uses our body for God's purposes, it prospers. The apostle wished that the recipient, who was a beloved brother, outstanding in such a prosperity of his soul, might prosper in all things and in bodily health, just as his soul prospered in the divine life.

verses.text_gb: 有弟兄来[Cra]见证[Fn1]你持守真理，就是你在[Fn2]真理中[Fn3]行事为人，我就[Fn4]大大欢乐。
verses.text_big5: 有弟兄來[Cra]見證[Fn1]你持守真理，就是你在[Fn2]真理中[Fn3]行事為人，我就[Fn4]大大歡樂。
verses.text_en: For I rejoiced greatly at the brothers' coming and testifying to your steadfastness in the truth, even as you walk in truth.
verses.text_gb_plain: 有弟兄来见证你持守真理，就是你在真理中行事为人，我就大大欢乐。
verses.text_big5_plain: 有弟兄來見證你持守真理，就是你在真理中行事為人，我就大大歡樂。

footnotes.zh: 你持守真理，直译，你的真理。这是关于基督，特别是关于祂神格的真理(见约贰1注5)，这真理的启示定规受信者的生活方式，并成为受信者持守的基本信仰。这乃是客观的真理，在受信者日常行事为人中，成了主观的真理。
footnotes.zh_big5: 你持守真理，直譯，你的真理。這是關於基督，特別是關於祂神格的真理，（見約貳1註5，）這真理的啟示定規受信者的生活方式，並成為受信者持守的基本信仰。這乃是客觀的真理，在受信者日常行事為人中，成了主觀的真理。
footnotes.en: 1:3 1 rejoiced See note 2 John 1:4 1 .

footnotes.zh: 见约贰4注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見約貳4註2。
footnotes.en: 1:3 2 your Lit., your truth. This is the truth concerning Christ, especially His deity (see note 2 John 1:1 5 ). By the revelation of this truth the recipient's way of life was determined, and the recipient held to this truth as his fundamental belief. It is the objective truth that had become subjective in the recipient's daily walk.

footnotes.zh: 受信者不仅持守真理，也在真理中行事为人。关于基督身位的真理不仅该是我们的信仰，也该是我们的生活，就是一种见证我们信仰的生活。
footnotes.zh_big5: 受信者不僅持守真理，也在真理中行事為人。關於基督身位的真理不僅該是我們的信仰，也該是我們的生活，就是一種見證我們信仰的生活。
footnotes.en: 1:3 3 walk The recipient not only held to the truth but also walked and lived in the truth. The truth concerning the person of Christ should be not only our belief but also our living, a living that testifies to our belief.

footnotes.zh: 见约贰4注3。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見約貳4註3。
footnotes.en: 1:3 4 truth See note 2 John 1:4 2 . So also in v. 4.

refs.text_gb: 他们在召会面前见证了你的爱；你照着与神相配的，送他们往前行，就作得好；
refs.text_big5: 他們在召會面前見證了你的愛；你照著與神相配的，送他們往前行，就作得好；
refs.text_en: Who testified to your love before the church; whom you will do well to send forward in a manner worthy of God;

refs.text_gb: 有众人给低米丢作见证，又有真理本身给他作见证，就是我们也给他作见证，你也知道我们的见证是真的。
refs.text_big5: 有眾人給低米丟作見證，又有真理本身給他作見證，就是我們也給他作見證，你也知道我們的見證是真的。
refs.text_en: To Demetrius testimony has been borne by all and by the truth itself; and we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

verses.text_big5: 我聽見我的[Cra]兒女們在[Fn1][Crb]真理中行事為人，我的喜樂就沒有比這個更大的。
verses.text_en: I have no greater joy than these things, that I hear that my children are walking in the truth.

verses.text_big5_plain: 我聽見我的兒女們在真理中行事為人，我的喜樂就沒有比這個更大的。

refs.text_gb: 我写这些话，不是羞辱你们，乃像劝戒我亲爱的儿女一样。
refs.text_big5: 我寫這些話，不是羞辱你們，乃像勸戒我親愛的兒女一樣。
refs.text_en: It is not to shame you that I write these things but to admonish you as my beloved children.

refs.text_gb: 你们在基督里，纵有上万的导师，父亲却不多，因为是我在基督耶稣里借着福音生了你们。
refs.text_big5: 你們在基督裏，縱有上萬的導師，父親卻不多，因為是我在基督耶穌裏藉著福音生了你們。
refs.text_en: For though you have ten thousand guides in Christ, yet you do not have many fathers; for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.

refs.text_gb: 正如你们所知道的，我们怎样劝勉你们，抚慰你们，向你们作见证，待你们每一个人，好像父亲待自己的孩子一样；
refs.text_big5: 正如你們所知道的，我們怎樣勸勉你們，撫慰你們，向你們作見證，待你們每一個人，好像父親待自己的孩子一樣；
refs.text_en: Just as you know how we were to each one of you, as a father to his own children, exhorting you and consoling you and testifying,

refs.text_gb: 写信给那凭信作我真孩子的提摩太：愿恩典、怜悯、平安，从父神和我们的主基督耶稣归与你。
refs.text_big5: 寫信給那憑信作我真孩子的提摩太：願恩典、憐憫、平安，從父神和我們的主基督耶穌歸與你。
refs.text_en: To Timothy, genuine child in faith: Grace, mercy, peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

refs.text_gb: 写信给我亲爱的孩子提摩太：愿恩典、怜悯、平安，从父神和我们的主基督耶稣归与你。
refs.text_big5: 寫信給我親愛的孩子提摩太：願恩典、憐憫、平安，從父神和我們的主基督耶穌歸與你。
refs.text_en: To Timothy, beloved child: Grace, mercy, peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

refs.text_gb: 写信给照着共同的信仰，作我真孩子的提多：愿恩典与平安，从父神和我们的救主基督耶稣归与你。
refs.text_big5: 寫信給照著共同的信仰，作我真孩子的提多：願恩典與平安，從父神和我們的救主基督耶穌歸與你。
refs.text_en: To Titus, genuine child according to the common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.

refs.text_gb: 就是为我在捆锁中所生的孩子欧尼西母恳求你；
refs.text_big5: 就是為我在捆鎖中所生的孩子歐尼西母懇求你；
refs.text_en: I entreat you concerning my child, whom I have begotten in my bonds, Onesimus,

refs.text_gb: 你当买真理，不可出卖；要买智慧、训诲和聪明。
refs.text_big5: 你當買真理，不可出賣；要買智慧、訓誨和聰明。
refs.text_en: Buy truth, and do not sell it; / Buy wisdom and instruction and understanding.

footnotes.en: 1:9 2 Diotrephes The Greek word is made up of of Zeus (Zeus was the chief of the gods in the Greek pantheon) and to nourish; hence, Zeus-nourished. This indicates that Diotrephes, a professing Christian, never dropped his pagan name, contrary to the practice of the early believers, who took a Christian name at their baptism. According to history, he advocated the Gnostic heresy, which blasphemed the person of Christ. It is no wonder that he mingled with the believers as one who loved to be first among them.

footnotes.zh: 原文由“丢斯(希腊庙宇中众神之首)的”和“滋养”所构成，因此，是“丢斯所滋养的。”这指明自称基督徒的丢特腓从未丢弃他异教徒的名字。这与早期信徒在受浸时取基督徒名字的作法相悖。根据历史，他倡导亵渎基督之身位的智慧派异端。难怪他搀在信徒中间，是一个好为首的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文由“丟斯（希臘廟宇中眾神之首）的”和“滋養”所構成，因此，是“丟斯所滋養的。”這指明自稱基督徒的丟特腓從未丟棄他異教徒的名字。這與早期信徒在受浸時取基督徒名字的作法相悖。根據歷史，他倡導褻瀆基督之身位的智慧派異端。難怪他攙在信徒中間，是一個好為首的。
footnotes.en: 1:9 3 to This is against the words of the Lord in Matt. 20:25-27 and Matt. 23:8-11, which keep all His believers on the same level, that of brothers. In 2 John 1:9 the Cerinthian Gnostics took the lead to advance in doctrine beyond the teaching concerning Christ. Here in 3 John 1:9 is one who was under the influence of Gnostic heretical doctrine and loved to be first in the church. The former was a matter of intellectual arrogance; the latter, of self-exaltation in one's actions. These two evils are sharp weapons used by God's enemy, Satan, to execute his evil plot against God's economy. One damages the believers' faith in the divine reality; the other frustrates the believers' work in God's move.

footnotes.zh_big5: 原文意，作行善的人（為著施惠或盡責），實行良善，因此是行善。
footnotes.en: 1:11 2 does The Greek word means to be a well-doer (as a favor or a duty), practicing good; hence, to do good.

footnotes.zh: 或，属于(见约壹五19注1)。神是善的源头。作好事的人，行善的人，乃是出于神而属于神的人(参约壹三8)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，屬於。（見約壹五19註1。）神是善的源頭。作好事的人，行善的人，乃是出於神而屬於神的人。（參約壹三8。）
footnotes.en: 1:11 3 of Lit., out of (see note 1 John 5:19 1 ). God is the source of good. A well-doer, a doer of good, is one who is out of God and who belongs to God (cf. 1 John 3:8).

footnotes.zh: 原文意，作行恶的人，实行邪恶，因此是行恶。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文意，作行惡的人，實行邪惡，因此是行惡。
footnotes.en: 1:11 4 does The Greek word means to be an evildoer, practicing evil; hence, to do evil.

footnotes.zh: 行恶的人不仅不是出于神，甚至也未曾见过神。
footnotes.zh_big5: 行惡的人不僅不是出於神，甚至也未曾見過神。
footnotes.en: 1:11 5 not An evildoer not only is not out of God but has not even seen God.

refs.text_gb: 所以我恳求你们要效法我。
refs.text_big5: 所以我懇求你們要效法我。
refs.text_en: I exhort you therefore, Become imitators of me.

refs.text_gb: 你们要效法我，像我效法基督一样。
refs.text_big5: 你們要效法我，像我效法基督一樣。
refs.text_en: Be imitators of me, as I also am of Christ.

crossrefs.label: b
crossrefs.raw: 彼前三11，诗三四14，三七27，赛一16～17

refs.text_gb: 也要离恶行善，寻求和睦，竭力追逐；
refs.text_big5: 也要離惡行善，尋求和睦，竭力追逐；
refs.text_en: And let him turn away from evil and do good; let him seek peace and pursue it;

refs.text_gb: 要离恶行善，寻求和睦，一心追赶。
refs.text_big5: 要離惡行善，尋求和睦，一心追趕。
refs.text_en: Turn away from evil and do good; / Seek peace and pursue it.

refs.text_gb: 你当离恶行善，就可永远安居。
refs.text_big5: 你當離惡行善，就可永遠安居。
refs.text_en: Turn away from evil and do good, / And abide forever.

refs.text_gb: 你们要洗濯自己，洁净自己；从我眼前除掉你们的恶行；要止住作恶，
refs.text_big5: 你們要洗濯自己，潔淨自己；從我眼前除掉你們的惡行；要止住作惡，
refs.text_en: Wash yourselves; cleanse yourselves. / Turn away the evil of your deeds / From before My eyes. / Cease doing what is evil;

refs.text_gb: 学习行善；寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。
refs.text_big5: 學習行善；尋求公平，解救受欺壓的；給孤兒伸冤，為寡婦辨屈。
refs.text_en: Learn to do good. / Seek justice; / Correct the ruthless. / Defend the orphan; / Plead for the widow.

refs.text_gb: 行善的归到生命的复活，作恶的归到审判的复活。
refs.text_big5: 行善的歸到生命的復活，作惡的歸到審判的復活。
refs.text_en: And will come forth: those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have practiced evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

refs.text_gb: 凡住在祂里面的，就不犯罪；凡犯罪的，是未曾看见祂，也未曾认识祂。
refs.text_big5: 凡住在祂裏面的，就不犯罪；凡犯罪的，是未曾看見祂，也未曾認識祂。
refs.text_en: Everyone who abides in Him does not sin; everyone who sins has not seen Him or known Him.

verses.text_gb: 有[Fn1]众人给[Fn2]低米丢作[Cra]见证，又有[Fn3]真理本身给他作见证，就是[Fn4]我们也给他作见证，你也知道我们的见证是[Fn5][Crb]真的。
verses.text_big5: 有[Fn1]眾人給[Fn2]低米丟作[Cra]見證，又有[Fn3]真理本身給他作見證，就是[Fn4]我們也給他作見證，你也知道我們的見證是[Fn5][Crb]真的。
verses.text_en: To Demetrius testimony has been borne by all and by the truth itself; and we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
verses.text_gb_plain: 有众人给低米丢作见证，又有真理本身给他作见证，就是我们也给他作见证，你也知道我们的见证是真的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 有眾人給低米丟作見證，又有真理本身給他作見證，就是我們也給他作見證，你也知道我們的見證是真的。

footnotes.zh: 这指明低米丢必定是在众召会中作工的弟兄，因而是众所周知的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明低米丟必定是在眾召會中作工的弟兄，因而是眾所周知的。
footnotes.en: 1:12 1 Demetrius Demetrius, who might have been one of the brothers who traveled in working for the Lord (vv. 5-8), perhaps was the one who bore this Epistle to Gaius. Hence, it was necessary that he receive a favorable and strong commendation from the writer.

footnotes.zh: 低米丢也许是一位出外为主作工的弟兄(5～8)，可能也是把本书信带给该犹的人。因此，需要作者为他作美好、有力的推荐。
footnotes.zh_big5: 低米丟也許是一位出外為主作工的弟兄，（5～8，）可能也是把本書信帶給該猶的人。因此，需要作者為他作美好、有力的推薦。
footnotes.en: 1:12 2 all This indicates that Demetrius must have been a brother working among the churches, and thus was well known.

footnotes.zh: 指神那启示出来的真理，作基督徒信仰之素质的实际(见约壹一6注6)，是所有信徒行事为人的神圣法则，信徒的行事为人也由这真理定规。因此，这真理给那行在其中的人作美好的见证，正如给低米丢作的见证一样。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指神那啟示出來的真理，作基督徒信仰之素質的實際，（見約壹一6註6，）是所有信徒行事為人的神聖法則，信徒的行事為人也由這真理定規。因此，這真理給那行在其中的人作美好的見證，正如給低米丟作的見證一樣。
footnotes.en: 1:12 3 truth The revealed truth of God as the reality of the essence of the Christian faith (see note 1 John 1:6 6 ). This truth is the divine rule for the walk of all believers, and by it the believers' walk is determined. Thus, it gives good testimony to him who walks in it, as it did to Demetrius.

footnotes.zh: 指使徒约翰并他的同人。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指使徒約翰並他的同人。
footnotes.en: 1:12 4 we The apostle John and his associates.

footnotes.zh: 原文为与“真理(实际)”同源的另一个形容词(参约壹五20注5)，意真正的、实际的，因此是真的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文為與“真理（實際）”同源的另一個形容詞，（參約壹五20註5，）意真正的、實際的，因此是真的。
footnotes.en: 1:12 5 true The Greek word (an adjective akin to truth (reality) — cf. note 1 John 5:20 5 ) means genuine, real; hence, true.

refs.text_gb: 有弟兄来见证你持守真理，就是你在真理中行事为人，我就大大欢乐。
refs.text_big5: 有弟兄來見證你持守真理，就是你在真理中行事為人，我就大大歡樂。
refs.text_en: For I rejoiced greatly at the brothers' coming and testifying to your steadfastness in the truth, even as you walk in truth.

refs.text_gb: 他们在召会面前见证了你的爱；你照着与神相配的，送他们往前行，就作得好；
refs.text_big5: 他們在召會面前見證了你的愛；你照著與神相配的，送他們往前行，就作得好；
refs.text_en: Who testified to your love before the church; whom you will do well to send forward in a manner worthy of God;

refs.text_gb: 那看见的人就作见证，他的见证也是真实的，并且他知道自己所说的是真实的，叫你们也可以信。
refs.text_big5: 那看見的人就作見證，他的見證也是真實的，並且他知道自己所說的是真實的，叫你們也可以信。
refs.text_en: And he who has seen this has testified, and his testimony is true; and he knows that he says what is true, that you also may believe.

refs.text_gb: 为这些事作见证，并且记载这些事的，就是这门徒；我们也知道他的见证是真实的。
refs.text_big5: 為這些事作見證，並且記載這些事的，就是這門徒；我們也知道他的見證是真實的。
refs.text_en: This is the disciple who testifies concerning these things, and the one who has written these things; and we know that his testimony is true.

verses.text_gb: 我原有[Cra]许多事要写给你，却不愿意用笔墨写给你；
verses.text_big5: 我原有[Cra]許多事要寫給你，卻不願意用筆墨寫給你；
verses.text_en: I had many things to write to you, but I do not want to write to you with ink and pen;
verses.text_gb_plain: 我原有许多事要写给你，却不愿意用笔墨写给你；
verses.text_big5_plain: 我原有許多事要寫給你，卻不願意用筆墨寫給你；

refs.text_gb: 我还有许多事要写给你们，却不愿意用纸墨写出来；但盼望到你们那里，与你们当面交谈，使我们的喜乐得以满足。
refs.text_big5: 我還有許多事要寫給你們，卻不願意用紙墨寫出來；但盼望到你們那裏，與你們當面交談，使我們的喜樂得以滿足。
refs.text_en: Though I have many things to write to you, I do not want to do so with paper and ink, but I am hoping to be with you and to speak face to face that our joy may be made full.

verses.text_gb: 但[Fn1][Cra]盼望快快地见你，我们[Fn2]当面交谈。[Fn3]愿你平安。[Crb]朋友们都问你安。请你替我按着[Crc]姓名问朋友们安。
verses.text_big5: 但[Fn1][Cra]盼望快快的見你，我們[Fn2]當面交談。[Fn3]願你平安。[Crb]朋友們都問你安。請你替我按著[Crc]姓名問朋友們安。
verses.text_en: But I hope to see you shortly, and we will speak face to face. Peace to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但盼望快快地见你，我们当面交谈。愿你平安。朋友们都问你安。请你替我按着姓名问朋友们安。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但盼望快快的見你，我們當面交談。願你平安。朋友們都問你安。請你替我按著姓名問朋友們安。

footnotes.zh: 见约贰12注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見約貳12註1。
footnotes.en: 1:14 1 hope See note 2 John 1:12 1 .

footnotes.zh: 直译，口对口。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，口對口。
footnotes.en: 1:14 2 face Lit., mouth to mouth.

footnotes.zh: 直译，愿平安归与你。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，願平安歸與你。

refs.text_gb: 我还有许多事要写给你们，却不愿意用纸墨写出来；但盼望到你们那里，与你们当面交谈，使我们的喜乐得以满足。
refs.text_big5: 我還有許多事要寫給你們，卻不願意用紙墨寫出來；但盼望到你們那裏，與你們當面交談，使我們的喜樂得以滿足。
refs.text_en: Though I have many things to write to you, I do not want to do so with paper and ink, but I am hoping to be with you and to speak face to face that our joy may be made full.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣说了这话，随后对他们说，我们的朋友拉撒路睡了，我要去叫醒他。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌說了這話，隨後對他們說，我們的朋友拉撒路睡了，我要去叫醒他。
refs.text_en: He said these things, and after this He said to them, Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going that I may wake him out of sleep.

refs.text_gb: 看门的就给他开门，羊也听他的声音；他按着名叫自己的羊，领它们出来。
refs.text_big5: 看門的就給他開門，羊也聽他的聲音；他按著名叫自己的羊，領牠們出來。
refs.text_en: To him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice; and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
